headword: {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}

definitions.explanation: A term indicating that no delivery fee is charged for an order, commonly seen in online shopping and retail.

examples.japanese: {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}で{届|とど}けてくれる。
examples.english: They deliver it with free shipping.

examples.japanese: 3,000{円以上|えんいじょう}で{送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}になる。
examples.english: Orders over 3,000 yen qualify for free shipping.

examples.japanese: {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}のキャンペーン{中|ちゅう}なので、まとめて{買|か}おうと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: Since there's a free shipping campaign right now, I think I'll buy in bulk.

notes:
A compound of {送料|そうりょう} (shipping fee) and {無料|むりょう} (free of charge). One of the most commonly seen phrases in online shopping in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}キャンペーン: free shipping campaign
- {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}ライン: free shipping threshold
- {全品|ぜんぴん}{送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}: free shipping on all items
- {送料無料|そうりょうむりょう}{対象|たいしょう}: eligible for free shipping

RELATED WORDS:
- {送料|そうりょう}: shipping fee
- {送料込|そうりょうこ}み: shipping included (in the price)
- {送料別|そうりょうべつ}: shipping charged separately
- {着払|ちゃくばら}い: cash on delivery (recipient pays shipping)
